info.name: IT Support Desk API (Activity 7)
info.description: Tests from the ICT251 Activity 7 brief, Step 7. Set the collection variable baseUrl to http://localhost:3000 for local tests or to your Render URL for hosted tests. Run the requests in order (Run collection).

exec: pm.test('200 and HTML guide', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('text/html'); });

pm.test('Guide shows student number and routes', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.include('202508518'); pm.expect(t).to.include('/api/records'); pm.expect(t).to.include('/health'); });
pm.test('200 and database connected', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().database).to.eql('connected'); });
pm.test('200 and a JSON array', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('countBefore', pm.response.json().length);

item.name: 04 POST valid record (client id ignored, spaces trimmed)

exec: const r = pm.response.json();
pm.test('201 Created', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('Has a new positive id (not the 999 we sent)', () => { pm.expect(r.id).to.be.a('number').above(0); pm.expect(r.id).to.not.eql(999); });
pm.test('Values saved and trimmed', () => { pm.expect(r.title).to.eql('Mouse not working in Lab A'); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('Pending'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('newId', r.id);

body.raw:
{
  "id": 999,
  "title": "  Mouse not working in Lab A  ",
  "category": "Hardware",
  "description": "The USB mouse on PC 12 does not move the pointer.",
  "status": "Pending"
}

item.name: 05 GET the new record by id

exec: pm.test('200 and the exact record created', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('newId'))); pm.expect(r.title).to.eql('Mouse not working in Lab A'); });

item.name: 06 PUT the same id (all four fields)

exec: const r = pm.response.json();

pm.test('200, changed values, original id', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(r.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('newId'))); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('Completed'); pm.expect(r.title).to.eql('Mouse replaced in Lab A'); });
pm.test('200 and deletion message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ message: 'Record deleted.' }); });
pm.test('404 with JSON message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('400 with useful message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Title is required.'); });
pm.test('400 with useful message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Status must be Pending, In progress or Completed.'); });

item.name: 11 POST spaces only and wrong types gives 400

exec: const r = pm.response.json();

pm.test('400 and lists every problem', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(r.message).to.eql('Title must have 3 to 80 characters.'); pm.expect(r.errors).to.include('Category must be text.'); });

item.name: 12 No new rows were created by the bad requests

exec: pm.test('Count is the same as before the tests', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('countBefore'))); });
pm.test('400 with JSON message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Id must be a positive whole number.'); });
pm.test('400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('400 with JSON message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('The request body is not valid JSON.'); });
pm.test('404', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('not found'); });

item.name: 17 PUT missing positive id gives 404 (does not create)

exec: pm.test('404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('404 with JSON message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('was not found'); });
